notes: Prompt gen-valuation v1. I used mapping.json, narrative.json and assumptions.json as inputs and did not change them. Inputs: peers NVDA, AVGO, MRVL, INTC (compute/data-center silicon designers; code median TTM EV/Sales about 16.3x); WACC 11.5%; terminal growth 3.0%; revenue growth for years 2-5 of 25%, 18%, 12%, 8% after code NTM revenue of about $73.1B; FCF margin rising from 18% to 24%, grounded in mapped CFO minus capex (TTM 15.5%, FY2025 19.4% including discontinued ops, 9M2026 before working capital about 23.6%); dcf_weight 0.7. A check run of eu.py compute gives terminal value at 73% of EV (below 80%), DCF about $186/share, peer value about $450/share, blended TP 265, Underperform against the $483.90 close of 2026-11-03. Inputs were chosen on fundamentals and not tuned toward any target price or rating. The DCF sits far below the market price: the price implies much higher sustained growth or margins than I assume. My scratch sensitivity, for information only and not a computed output: WACC 10% gives about $228 DCF/share; terminal growth 4% about $205; FCF margins 4 pts higher about $217. Net-cash items for the lead to consider routing to gen-mapping (I judge none of them a mapping error): (1) long-term marketable equity securities of $1.3B and non-marketable equity/other securities of $1.9B (periodic.txt Item 3) are excluded from net cash, which is conservative and about $1.9/share; (2) the $1.2B customer-warrant liability in other long-term liabilities is non-cash and settles in shares, so it is correctly excluded from debt; (3) the pending Taalas acquisition (cash and stock, about $2.9B including up to $1.4B contingent) and World Labs (all stock, about $8.2B) are not in net cash or share count. Unresolved: customer warrants for up to 320M shares at a $0.01 exercise price (periodic.txt) are not in the 1,661M diluted share base; full vesting would cut per-share value by up to about 16%. CFO history for FY2025 includes discontinued ZT Manufacturing operating cash ($920M for 9M2025), which slightly inflates the FY2025 FCF margin; this is taken into account in the fcf_margin rationale. The compute run raised gate finding gate-guidance-opex_next_q (major; narrative guidance value for opex_next_q is not visible in quote Q-3 '~$3.75 Billion').
